title: NationalBrand
description: A single hardcoded national brand entry in the safe directory. Consumed identically by the FastAPI backend and the SwiftUI app.

id.description: Stable slug used as a primary key everywhere. Never change once shipped.

name.description: Display name. Rendered as bold TEXT only — never a logo graphic — to avoid trademark issues.

category.description: Must be one of the categories listed in the dataset's top-level categories array.

support_type.description: 'phone' = dialable; 'online_only' = brand offers NO phone support. When 'online_only', phone MUST be null and the app MUST show the no-phone-support warning instead of dialing.

phone.description: E.164 number passed to the native dialer. MUST be null when support_type is 'online_only'.

phone_display.description: Human-readable number shown in the UI (e.g. '1-800-275-2753'). Null when support_type is 'online_only'.

brand_color_hex.description: Official signature corporate color used as the button background.

text_color_hex.description: Foreground color chosen for high contrast against brand_color_hex (WCAG AA target for large text).

safety_warning.description: Category-specific just-in-time warning shown on the 3-second full-screen safety prompt before dialing.

official_support_url.description: Authoritative page used to human-verify the phone number during the verification process.

verification.description: Provenance / data-integrity record. The directory may not be marketed as 'verified' until status is 'verified'.

status.description: 'unverified_seed' = dev placeholder; 'verified' = a human confirmed it against source on verified_on; 'flagged_stale' = freshness check failed, do not display until re-verified.

source.description: URL the human used to confirm the number.

verified_on.description: ISO date of last human verification.

verified_by.description: Identifier of the reviewer who verified the entry.
